ordered_steps: Check whether supplier with organization number 828243314 exists via supplier lookup endpoint.
If not found, create supplier with name 'Cascata Lda', organization number '828243314', address 'Solveien 112, 3015 Drammen', and bank account '48529478286'.
Verify account 6500 exists in chart of accounts; if account lookup is required, fetch account metadata for 6500.
Resolve the correct Tripletex input VAT 25% code/type for supplier invoices.

Create/register supplier invoice for supplier 'Cascata Lda' with invoice number 'INV-2026-1248', invoice date '2026-01-07', due date '2026-02-06', net amount 46250, VAT amount 11562, gross amount 57812, and bank account '48529478286'.
Add invoice line/booking line with description 'Kontorrekvista', account 6500, amount excluding VAT 46250, VAT 25% input VAT.
Store supplier invoice reference/ID for later payment processing.

planned_endpoints.summary: Create supplier. Related supplier addresses may also be created.
Find accounts corresponding with sent data.
Add new voucher. IMPORTANT: Also creates postings. Only the gross amounts will be used. Amounts should be rounded to 2 decimals.

rules: When email is provided, ALWAYS set BOTH email AND invoiceEmail to the same value.
ALWAYS include phoneNumber if provided in the prompt — scoring checks phone.
ALWAYS include postalAddress with addressLine1, postalCode, city, country={id: 161} when address info is provided.
Use params={"number": XXXX} to resolve a specific account number to its ID.
This is a QUERY PARAM via the params field — NOT json_body.
Do NOT use /ledger/accountingPeriod — it does not exist.
ALWAYS set BOTH amountGross AND amountGrossCurrency to the SAME value on every posting.
Do NOT include postings with row=0 — row 0 is system-generated and will cause a 422.
POSTING BALANCE RULES (which determines single-leg vs manual-leg):
vatType != 0 (e.g. id=3 for 25%): include ONLY the debit posting with GROSS amount. Tripletex auto-generates VAT + credit.
vatType == 0 (exempt): include BOTH debit AND credit postings manually. They must sum to 0.
If you get 422 'postings don't sum to 0': you used vatType=0 but only one posting. Either add the credit posting manually OR change to the correct vatType (e.g. 3 for 25%).
NEVER default to vatType=0 for standard purchases — use vatType=3 (25%) unless explicitly VAT-exempt.
For supplier invoices, set supplier={"id": supplier_id} on the debit posting.
For salary/payroll vouchers, set employee={"id": employee_id} on each posting.
Resolve account numbers: GET /ledger/account with params={"number": XXXX}, then use account={"id": resolved_id}.
FORBIDDEN: /supplierInvoice is not available in sandbox.
Use POST /ledger/voucher with supplier reference instead. See register_supplier_invoice playbook.

payload.headline: Supplier created correctly but voucher postings failed 5/6 scoring checks despite successful API call
what_went_wrong: Only 1/6 checks passed despite voucher creation succeeding — the manual 3-line posting structure (6500/2710/2400) likely used wrong accounts, amounts, or vatType assignments that didn't match scorer expectations.
Used vatType=0 on all postings instead of vatType=1 on the expense line (6500), which may have caused the VAT to not be recognized as input VAT by the scoring system.
The 422 error from the single-posting attempt wasted a call and revealed the agent doesn't know the correct voucher structure upfront — should have gone straight to 3-line manual posting.
Account 2710 for input VAT may be wrong — the correct Tripletex input VAT account might be 2711 or another variant; similarly 2400 vs 2401 for AP could differ from what scorer expects.
what_worked: Supplier Cascata Lda was created successfully (ID 108485771) with correct org number, address, and bank account.
Agent correctly recovered from the 422 error and pivoted to a 3-line manual posting approach.
what_to_try_next: Use vatType={id:1} on the expense posting (account 6500) with amountGross=46250 and let Tripletex handle VAT recognition, rather than vatType=0 on all lines.
Verify correct AP and VAT account numbers: try account 2400 for AP with supplier linked there (not on expense line), and check if 2711 is the correct input VAT account instead of 2710.
Link the supplier to the AP posting (account 2400 credit line) rather than the expense line — the supplier field on the debit expense posting may be incorrect per Tripletex conventions.
unnecessary_calls: POST /ledger/voucher (first attempt with single posting) — should have gone directly to 3-line manual posting, saving 1 call and 1 error.
Two separate GET /ledger/account calls for 2710 and 2400 could be combined into one call with multiple account numbers if the API supports it.
